neighbours.label: The token 'Table' opening a parenthetical table reference, '(Table N)', in scientific prose. Lower-case 'table' is quiet; ' Table' with a leading space and 'Figure' fire only weakly.

quiet: Mortality was highest among patients older than seventy (Figure 1).
